title: Lightly Molten Spanish Shungiku Paella
description: A diabetic friendly Spanish dish featuring shungiku, with a jammy and molten texture, made with deep fry tod for a cozy meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the crushed deep fry tod and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the chopped shungiku and cook until it is wilted.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and saffron threads, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Remove the cover and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the liquid is mostly absorbed and the paella is lightly molten.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
